About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.
About the Role:
We are seeking a Director, Cloud Infrastructure to lead the infrastructure, reliability, and security foundation that runs HighLevel as we expand into new regions.

Reporting to the VP, Cloud & Platform Engineering, you will lead a ~35–40 person organisation through Engineering Managers. This role is responsible for:

Designing and operating scalable, multi-region cloud infrastructure on GCP

Owning DevOps, CI/CD, and release engineering for all product teams

Delivering 24x7 operations, SRE, and incident management across time zones

Leading security, compliance, and data residency for infrastructure

Defining and executing infrastructure automation, FinOps, and cost strategies

Driving AI adoption in infrastructure and operations with strong governance

This is a strategic and execution-focused leadership role, critical to HighLevel's ability to grow globally while operating with strong reliability, security, and cost discipline.
Responsibilities:
Cloud Architecture, Resiliency & Multi-Region Strategy

Own the strategy and architecture for HighLevel's GCP footprint, including:

GKE and distributed compute

Networking, edge, and global traffic management

Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and environment standards

Lead the build-out of new production regions, using a scalable model (global control plane, regional data planes).

Architect and oversee highly resilient infrastructure, including:

Multi-region failover strategies

Disaster recovery and business continuity

Capacity planning and region-readiness standards

Design for 99.99%+ availability across critical systems.

Data Residency & Regional Compliance

Ensure customer data is stored and processed in-region where required, with enforced, auditable controls.

Partner with Database Engineering and Platform Services on:

Tenant-to-region placement and routing

Cross-region replication and backup policies

Egress and data-movement controls

Make data residency a repeatable capability for future regions.

DevOps, CI/CD & Release Engineering

Own CI/CD and the release platform used by all product engineering teams.

Evolve CI/CD to support:

High-velocity development driven by AI-generated code

Progressive delivery across regions (canary, staged region rollouts)

Automated rollback based on telemetry

Integrate:

Policy-as-code and security scanning

Software supply chain controls (artifact signing, provenance)

Track and improve DORA metrics (deploy frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore).

Operations, SRE & 24x7 CloudOps

Own platform availability, SLOs, and error budgets for every region.

Build and run 24x7 CloudOps coverage across time zones, with clear escalation to SRE and owning teams.

Lead incident management, blameless postmortems, DR drills, and game days.

Reduce toil through automation and self-healing systems.

Security & Compliance

Own cloud security posture across regions:

IAM and least-privilege access

KMS, encryption, and secrets management

Vulnerability management and security reviews

Act as executive owner for infrastructure audit evidence (SOC 2, ISO 27001), partnering with the CyberSecurity and GRC teams.

Establish governance for AI usage in infrastructure and developer tooling.

AI-Enabled Operations

Lead adoption of AI across infrastructure and operations:

AIOps for anomaly detection and alert noise reduction

Incident copilots and AI-assisted runbooks

AI-assisted infrastructure automation

Measure the impact of AI on toil, reliability, and delivery speed.

Cost Optimization & Efficiency

Own the cloud infrastructure budget and FinOps practice:

Cost visibility per region, service, and tenant

Right-sizing, commitments, autoscaling, and lifecycle policies

Regular savings and forecast reporting

Balance performance, reliability, and cost as new regions come online.

Leadership & Organization Development

Build and lead high-performing teams across:

DevOps & Infrastructure Engineering

Security & Compliance

Region & Data Residency Engineering

Operations, SRE & CloudOps

Develop managers (including first-time managers), leads, and Staff Engineers.

Establish clear ownership, accountability, and growth paths.

Foster a culture of reliability, security, and operational excellence.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

Database Engineering, Platform Services, and FrontEnd Platform

Product Engineering teams to enable safe, fast delivery

Security, GRC, and Support for governance and customer commitments

Act as a key technical leader in executive and enterprise customer discussions.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering or related field.

14+ years of experience in infrastructure, cloud, SRE, or DevOps engineering.

5+ years leading infrastructure organizations at scale, including managing managers.

Strong hands-on experience with:

Cloud platforms (GCP preferred)

Kubernetes (GKE) and distributed systems

Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar)

CI/CD and DevOps practices

Proven experience building or operating multi-region architectures, including failover and disaster recovery.

Ownership of 24x7 operations, incident management, SLOs, and on-call programs.

Working knowledge of cloud security, compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001), and data residency or privacy requirements.

Experience owning a cloud budget and delivering measurable cost reductions.

Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level discussions.
Nice to Have:
Experience launching a new cloud region with data residency requirements

Experience building 24x7 operations across time zones

Experience leading FinOps or cost-engineering programs at scale

Experience applying AI/AIOps to infrastructure operations

Experience in high-growth SaaS environments

Exposure to compliance and audit-driven environments
